meta.title: Murderers VS Sheriffs crates and box purchases
meta.coverageDecision: These four rows are exact-universe official developer-product box purchases. They are enough for a narrow box-purchase dataset, but not enough for a final public page promising which box to open because reward pools, odds, daily reset behavior, duplicate handling, and coin routes are not verified.

imageCoverage.decision: Rows use official Roblox thumbnail assets for the box products. PRO Box and PRO Box Daily share the same thumbnail image. GOD Box and GOD Box [Discount] share the same thumbnail image.

sources.label: Roblox developer-products API - universe 7219654364
sources.usage: Official exact-universe names, prices, sale state, product IDs, developer product IDs, and icon asset IDs for PRO Box, GOD Box, PRO Box Daily, and GOD Box [Discount].

sources.label: Roblox thumbnails API - box icon assets
sources.usage: Official thumbnail URLs used to create local box images.

blockers: Official APIs do not expose box reward pools.
Official APIs do not expose box odds or rarity chances.
Daily reset behavior, per-player purchase limits, and discount timing are not verified.
No coin or in-game currency box route has been verified.
Duplicate handling and tradeability of box rewards are not verified.
The route config does not yet include the crates collection for this game.
